resources.string: Calls not recognised as verified contacts are blocked without ringing and appear in Recent. Some saved contacts may also be blocked if they can\'t be recognised; you can call them back. If your saved contacts can\'t be read, calls may still ring.
Blocked calls won\'t ring, and blocked livestreams are hidden on this phone. People aren\'t notified when you block them.
Block someone from Recent (press and hold a row), from a contact, or with Decline and block on an incoming call.
Their calls will ring again and their livestreams will show in Live.
Block list can\'t be read. Calls aren\'t blocked until you reset it.
This block wasn\'t saved because the block list can\'t be read, so calls aren\'t blocked. Reset unblocks everyone; then you can block people again.
Couldn\'t reset the block list. Try again.
Everyone is unblocked and you can block people again.

Their livestreams will be hidden. Calls will be blocked when MeshLive can recognise their phone. Calls using a temporary ID may still ring; turn on Block unknown callers to stop those too. They won\'t be notified.
The block list is full. Unblock someone first.
Could not save the block. The block list cannot be read right now.
This caller\'s temporary ID can\'t be blocked for future calls. Turn on Block unknown callers to stop calls from people outside your verified contacts.
